description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelIcon, which is a widget used in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework to render icon UI elements in subpanels, including handling display logic and link generation based on user permissions and module data.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelIcon
classes.description: A widget class for rendering icons in subpanels, extending SugarWidgetField, with methods for displaying header cells and list entries with permission checks and dynamic content.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns a non-breaking space as header cell content for the subpanel icon.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying the icon in a list, with logic for permissions, target module, record links, images, and attachments.
